solution: If slopes are in ratio 1:2, using the identity \(\frac{(m+n)^2}{mn} = \frac{4h^2}{ab}\) with ratio 1:2: \(9ab = 8h^2\), so \(ab:h^2 = 8:9\). Matches option D.
note: identity printed as (m+n)^2 mn = 4h^2/ab; it is (m+n)^2/mn. Ratio 8:9 and key D unchanged.

solution:
Factor: \((x-2y+1)^2 + k(x-2y+1) = (x-2y+1)(x-2y+1+k) = 0\), giving the parallel lines \(x-2y+1 = 0\) and \(x-2y+(1+k) = 0\).

Perpendicular distance \(= \dfrac{|1 - (1+k)|}{\sqrt{1^2+(-2)^2}} = \dfrac{|k|}{\sqrt{5}}\). Setting \(\dfrac{|k|}{\sqrt{5}} = \sqrt{5}\) gives \(|k| = 5\), so \(k = \pm 5\); the option offered is \(k = 5\).
note: k = -5 also works; only 5 is offered. Key A unchanged.

solution: The equation factors as \((x - 2y)(x - 2y + k) = 0\): the parallel lines \(x - 2y = 0\) and \(x - 2y + k = 0\). Their distance is \(\dfrac{|k|}{\sqrt{5}} = 3\), so \(k = \pm 3\sqrt{5}\); the option offered is \(k = 3\sqrt{5}\).
note: k = -3 sqrt5 also works; only 3 sqrt5 is offered. Key D unchanged.
